title: Task Scenarios for Prototype Testing
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting task scenarios for prototype testing to prototype README traceability matrix connecting theory to screen changes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze how the prototype README traceability matrix connecting theory to screen changes shows a defensible decision in AIL 606.

Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to decide what help or design change should come next.
